LanguageData.Gun_PPD-40_RWP.label: PPD-40
LanguageData.Gun_PPD-40_RWP.description: The PPD-40 is a rapid-fire submachine gun known for its high rate of fire and drum magazine capacity. Originating from early 20th century Eastern regions, it’s perfect for close-quarters combat. However, its accuracy diminishes at longer ranges, making it ideal for short-range skirmishes and suppression tactics on the battlefield.
